The Souled Store Lists Founder's Office Intern Position in Mumbai Focused on GCC Expansion

Casual-wear and pop-culture merchandising brand The Souled Store has posted a job opening for a Founder's Office Intern based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. The role centers heavily on scaling the company's international retail footprint, with a primary focus on the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

Role Overview and Responsibilities

The position requires working closely with the Founders' Office to manage and expand international retail operations. Key responsibilities outlined in the listing include:

  • Managing existing retail stores in the GCC end-to-end to drive revenue, profitability, footfall, conversion, and average order value (AOV).
  • Leading new store launches across the GCC, covering market and location evaluation, commercial negotiations, partner coordination, and execution.
  • Overseeing daily store operations, quality control, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) compliance, and customer service.
  • Managing inventory planning, replenishment, stock allocation, logistics, and fulfillment.
  • Driving regional brand strategy, localized marketing campaigns, brand activations, and visual merchandising.
  • Owning regional P&L, budgets, operating costs, and cross-functional financial coordination.

Candidate Eligibility and Requirements

Applicants are expected to demonstrate specific qualifications for the internship:

  • Experience in retail, business operations, expansion, or business management, with international exposure preferred.
  • Strong commercial acumen alongside an understanding of P&L, inventory, and retail metrics.
  • High ownership, an entrepreneurial mindset, and cross-functional execution capabilities.
  • A willingness to travel across the GCC as required.
  • Availability for a compulsory six-month full-time internship based out of the office in Mumbai.

Practical Implications and Verification

For prospective applicants, understanding what is confirmed versus what remains unspecified is crucial before applying:

  • Confirmed Details: The employer is The Souled Store. The role is a Founder's Office Intern focusing on GCC retail expansion. The position is full-time, lasts for a compulsory six months, and is based in Mumbai with required travel to the GCC.
  • Unspecified Details: The salary, application deadline, exact selection process steps, and total number of openings are not specified in the official posting.

Readers interested in reviewing the complete listing details or submitting an application can visit the official LinkedIn Job Posting.
